label: Banking License Application Support
description: Structures and reviews banking license applications. Covers governance requirements, capital adequacy, business plan assessment, and regulatory engagement strategy.

claudeKnowledge.description: CRD VI banking license requirements, EBA internal governance guidelines, ECB licensing methodology, national licensing requirements

guidedInputs.label: Applicant description
guidedInputs.description: Describe the applicant: business model, ownership, proposed activities, and why a banking license is being sought.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Fintech company founded in 2021, currently operating as an EMI in Sweden. Seeking full banking license to offer deposits and lending to SME customers. 45 employees, €25M equity, profitable for 18 months. Seeking license for Sweden with potential EU passport.

options.label: Full banking license (CRD VI / national transposition)
Feasibility assessment — is a license achievable?
Regulatory dialogue — preparing for supervisor meetings

guidedInputs.label: Known challenges or concerns
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Ownership structure includes a non-EU holding company — unsure how this affects fit and proper assessment. Business plan shows capital adequacy tight in years 2-3. No current CRO — need to hire before application. Previous application withdrawn by related entity.

guidedInputs.label: Documents available for review (if any)
guidedInputs.description: List any draft documents available (business plan, governance framework, risk framework, etc.)
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Draft business plan v3, governance framework draft, proposed board composition...
